name: Yogurt
author: italian boy on based.cooking
steps: Pour the yogurt into the milk
Bring the milk to 45°C (113°F) again (don't go higher than that, please)
Boil some water (about 100ml) and use it to wash the thermos from inside
Let the water out and pour the milk into the thermos
Leave the thermos in the oven(or in any other place whithout air flow) for 12h

culture.text: Yogurt is a food produced by bacterial fermentation of milk. The bacteria ferment the sugars in the milk and produce lactic acid, which acts on milk protein to give yogurt its texture and characteristic tart flavor. Yogurt is most commonly made from cow's milk, but milk from water buffalo, goats, ewes, mares, camels, and yaks can also be used.
